definitions.short: something rolled , i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins ), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves )
definitions.full: H1530. gal גַּל noun masculine Gen 31:48 heap, wave, billow (as rolled together, rolling, rolling up ), also spring , ᵑ0 Song 4:12 compare 3 below — absolute גַּל Job 8:17 5 t. (including הַגַּל Gen 31:48 +); גָּ֑ל 31:46 ; הַגָּ֑ל 31:46 ; לַגָּ֑ל Isa 25:2 ; construct גַּלֿ Josh 7:26 + 2t. + Gen 31:47-48 , q.see below; plural גַּלִּים 2Kin 19:25 6 t.; construct גַּלֵּיֿ Isa 48:18 ; suffix גַּלָּיו Psa 89:10 6 t.; גַּלֵּיהֶם 65:8 2 t.; — 1 heap of stones, a. ׳ג אבנים raised ( הקים ) over dead body Josh 7:26 ; 8:29 ; compare 2Sam 18:17 (with הִצִּיב ). b. גַּל alone Job 8:17 (roots wrapped about it). c. heap or pile made ( עשׂה ) for use in ratifying compact of Jacob with Laban Gen 31:46 (twice in verse); 31:48 ; 31:51 ; Genesis 38:52; 31:52 (twice in verse) compare also גַּלְעֵד proper name, dual heap of ruins Isa 25:2 ; elsewhere plural Hosea 12:12 ; 2Kin 19:25 = Isa 37:26 ; Job 15:28 Jer 9:10 ; 51:37 . 2 waves (rollers) in poetry, only plural, waves of sea Jer 5:22 ; 31:35 ; Isa 51:15 ; Job 38:11 ; Psa 65:8 ; 89:10 ; 107:25 ; 107:29 ; compare also in simile Ezek 26:3 ; Isa 48:18 ( גַּלֵּיהַֿיָּם ); figurative of chastisements from ׳י Psa 42:8 (|| מִשְׁבָּרִים ) Jonah 2:3 (|| id.); of army of Babylon's conqueror Jer 51:42 , 55 ; compare Zech 10:11 (VB; but Bev JPh xviii. 88 proposes גִּבְלִים compare Ezek 27:9 ). 3 spring , Song 4:12 חָתוּם מַעְיָן נָעוּל גַּל כַּלָּ֑ה אֲחוֺתִי נָעוּל גַּן a garden barred (is) my sister, bride, a spring barred, a fountain sealed ; but גַּן for ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 גַּל .
